column1: # The recovery after the Places correction, row by row: every row it must reconcile, and the build,
# scope and run expected to execute it. The targets are the correction scope's 15 required rows
# (C1-C15) and the 56 earlier required executions (13 places, 16 signal, 27 regressions), plus the
# regressions scope's optional repeat B14, 72 lines in all; docs/verification/places-review-manifest.tsv
# Build 1 (Codemagic 6ab8adb4, on 907d7401) counts toward nothing. Build 2 (Codemagic
# 6ab8c585873de42fcd4f1a8a, scope correction, on 808950f) passed C10-C15 on the smaller iPhone; on the
# iPhone 17 Pro Max every run exited 65 before any test started (the test runner failed to initialize
# for UI testing). Two builds were left: build 3 (gate_finish) runs C1-C9 and, as extras, S3-S6, S8,
# P9-P13, S15 and S16; build 4 (sweep_finish) runs P1-P6, S9, S10, S12, S13, M1-M13, B1, B10-B13 and
# B15. B2-B9 (the Guest List's regressions_b tests) and the optional B14 are pending: no recovery build
# scripts/places_recovery_reconcile.py checks this file against the manifest and reconciles row by row:
# a target is covered by a PASSED execution (kind required or extra) of the same test on the same
# device class, in the same run type, in any given build whose git_head is product-equivalent to
# ProximeetDomain ProximeetUITests Proximeet.xcodeproj assets is empty). The build, scope and run here
# say where that execution is expected; an execution elsewhere that meets the rule counts too.
# Columns (tab-separated): target, requirement, test, class, build, scope, run, row, kind, note.
#   target       <scope>:<row> of the correction, places, signal or regressions scope.
#   requirement  required, or optional (repeat) for B14.
#   class        main = the iPhone 17 Pro Max model and runtime (the selected simulator, or device B, its
#                clone); small = the smaller iPhone (the iPhone 17e).
#   scope, run, row, kind   the executing row in the manifest (its kind: required or extra), or "pending"
#                and "-" when no recovery build runs it.
#   note         the stated identity exceptions: P1 runs with short holds, unrecorded (the places scope's
#                P1 was the recorded journey, full holds); M4-M13 run on device B instead of main (the
#                same model and runtime). "-" when there is none.
